barn.name: Barn Upgrade
barn.effect: Adds one animal-care capacity per level; Cloud Chicken remains available.

alchemy.name: Alchemy Workbench
alchemy.effect: Unlocks food, medicine and dragon recipes.

special_shop.name: Special Shop
special_shop.effect: Unlocks rare eggs and specialist supplies.

dragon_altar.name: Dragon Altar
dragon_altar.effect: Unlocks Dragon Island and elemental incubation. Once daily spend 5 Dragon Energy to recover up to 20 farm energy.

garden.name: Botanical Garden Upgrade
garden.effect: Adds one herb yield per harvest, capped at three.

pond.name: Fish Pond
pond.effect: Allows fish care and fish materials.

icehouse.name: Icehouse
icehouse.effect: Daily creature fullness and cleanliness decay reduced by two.

forge.name: Warm Forge
forge.effect: Queued crafting and incubation gain one extra progress per day.

serpent_den.name: Serpent Den
serpent_den.effect: Allows a serpent companion and disease resistance utility.

warehouse.name: Warehouse Upgrade
warehouse.effect: Unlocks larger forage batches without limiting existing inventory or dropping old items.
